morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，无马来语词缀；标准读音保留 /v/。下列词族成员为复合术语，并非加缀派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 从火山口或地表裂隙喷出、流出的高温熔融岩石；熔岩。
senses.en_definition: Molten rock erupted onto the Earth's surface through a volcano or fissure.
senses.ms_definition: Lahar; batuan cair bersuhu tinggi yang keluar dari gunung berapi atau rekahan ke permukaan bumi.
senses.nuances: 地下的熔融岩石称 magma，流出地表后称 lava。马来语词典以 lahar 释 lava；英语地质术语 lahar 则特指含水的火山碎屑泥流，翻译时须区分。[DBP：lava](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=lava)、[USGS：lahar](https://www.usgs.gov/news/science-snippet/earthword-lahar)。

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 地质监测报告
dual_scenarios.ms: Pasukan pemantau melaporkan bahawa aliran lava telah sampai ke kaki gunung.
dual_scenarios.zh: 监测小组报告说，熔岩流已到达山脚。
dual_scenarios.en: The monitoring team reported that the lava flow had reached the foot of the mountain.

etymology.historical_story: Lava belongs to an international scientific vocabulary whose European history leads through Italian to Latin words associated with falling or sliding. That image suits molten rock moving down a mountainside. Malay dictionaries recognize lava alongside lahar, but the immediate route by which lava entered Malay is not established by the supplied evidence. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/lava).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lava 的两个音节连成一条流动的红线：la—va，熔岩沿山坡往下流。此为画面助记，并非词源解释。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 中性的科学名词，适用于课堂、新闻和专业报告，没有特殊敬语要求。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 讨论真实灾情时使用客观措辞；lava、magma 和英语 lahar 所指不同，跨语言报道尤其需要分清。
